Completion holds the end position, replay starts at zero and seeking to the end creates no empty playback source
Stage asset JSON and local storage round-trip with invalid configuration rejection and corruption recovery
Real Three.js transforms and aperture world coordinates, LaserShow replacement/disposal and pipeline registration cleanup
